panels.description: Whether the economics mode is disabled, pending its first result, failed its latest result, or succeeded.
panels.title: Mode Status

panels.description: Declared connector fallback order and standard Solana RPC compatibility versus the command requirement. Available reflects whether the configured transport and capabilities satisfy the route.
panels.title: Economics Command Routes

panels.description: Connector that supplied each command's latest successful result. Compatibility columns describe only the standard Solana RPC surface, independently of provider-specific APIs.
panels.title: Latest Economics Sources
Tracked Validator Protocol Rewards
panels.description: Compares inflation rewards and reward-epoch production for the watched validators selected above. Missing rewards remain absent rather than rendering as zero.

One row per selected watched validator with independently collected reward-epoch block production. Reward panels below remain absent for validators without an inflation-reward sample; Reward Data Available quantifies current coverage.

targets.expr: max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_info{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_rewarded_blocks_latest_epoch{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} and on(network) (max by (network) (sol_mode_enabled{network="$network",mode="economics"}) == 1), "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

Reward Sample Epoch
panels.description: Epoch represented by the tracked-validator inflation reward and produced-block samples.

panels.title: Reward Data Available
panels.description: Percentage of selected watched validators with an inflation-reward sample. A missing sample is no data, not zero reward.
Epoch-sampled Solana inflation reward for each selected watched validator.
panels.title: Tracked Inflation Reward History

panels.description: Blocks produced by each selected watched validator during the sampled reward epoch.
panels.title: Tracked Rewarded Blocks History

panels.description: Inflation reward divided by produced blocks for each selected watched validator; absent when its reward sample is missing.

Configured Economics Target — Protocol Inflation
panels.description: These panels describe the single validator configured under modes.economics.validator, separate from the tracked-validator comparison above.

panels.title: Target Protocol Inflation Reward
panels.description: Latest Solana protocol inflation reward for the configured economics validator.

panels.title: Target Protocol Sample Epoch
panels.description: Epoch represented by the latest Solana protocol inflation reward sample. This is independent of each provider's settled reward epoch.

panels.title: Target Produced Blocks in Protocol Sample
panels.description: Blocks produced by the configured economics validator during the Solana protocol reward sample epoch.

Latest sampled Solana protocol inflation reward over observation time for the configured economics validator. The value is held until a new protocol sample epoch is collected; it is not intraday accrual.
panels.title: Target Protocol Inflation Reward History

panels.description: Latest sampled Solana protocol inflation reward per produced block over observation time for the configured economics validator. The value changes with the protocol sample epoch, not continuously within an epoch.
panels.title: Target Reward / Produced Block History
Configured Economics Target — Recent Block Fees
panels.description: These panels describe the single validator configured under modes.economics.validator, separate from the tracked-validator comparison above.

Validator fee reward in the latest sampled confirmed block. This includes Solana transaction fees and priority fees delivered by Harmonic when Harmonic built that block; the chain does not attribute the amount to a block-building provider.
panels.title: Latest Block Fee Reward

panels.description: Average validator fee reward across the recent produced blocks sampled from the configured economics validator's leader schedule.
panels.title: Recent Block Fee Average

panels.description: Absolute slot of the latest confirmed produced block represented by the fee-reward sample.
panels.title: Latest Sampled Block Slot

panels.description: Produced blocks represented by the current bounded fee-reward sample. Missed leader slots are omitted.
panels.title: Recent Produced Blocks Sampled

panels.description: Fee reward from the latest sampled confirmed produced block at each polling observation. Harmonic priority fees are included when Harmonic built the block, but are not separately attributable on-chain.
panels.title: Latest Block Fee Reward History

panels.description: Average validator fee reward across each bounded recent-block sample over the selected time range.
panels.title: Recent Block Fee Average History
Configured Economics Target — Jito MEV Rewards
panels.description: These panels describe the single validator configured under modes.economics.validator, separate from the tracked-validator comparison above.
Post-commission Jito MEV reward paid to the configured economics validator and its stakers. No data means no Jito route is configured, the selected epoch is not settled, or the route is unavailable.
panels.title: Latest Settled Jito Reward

panels.description: Validator MEV commission for the same settled epoch as the Jito reward.
panels.title: Jito MEV Commission

panels.description: Epoch represented by the latest settled Jito MEV reward.
panels.title: Jito Reward Epoch

panels.description: Latest settled Jito MEV reward over observation time for the configured economics validator. The value is held until Jito publishes another settled epoch; it is not intraday accrual.
panels.title: Jito MEV Reward History

panels.description: Jito MEV commission associated with each latest settled reward over observation time for the configured economics validator.
panels.title: Jito MEV Commission History
Watched Validators — Funding and Timing
panels.description: Funding rows follow the selected watched validators, and the reserve-wallet panel shows the configured economics reserve when its target is selected. Separate timing panels show network-wide epoch progress, recent slot duration, time to epoch end, and each selected validator's next leader ETA.

One row per selected watched validator. VAT reserve is the vote-account balance above rent exemption; runway counts complete future 0.8 SOL charges. Missing accounts or account-size data remain blank.

targets.expr: max by (validator_key, network, status, validator_identity, validator_vote_account) (label_join(label_join(label_join(sol_watched_validator_info{network="$network",identity=~"$validator"}, "validator_key", " / ", "identity", "vote_account"), "validator_identity", "", "identity"), "validator_vote_account", "", "vote_account"))

panels.title: Watched Validator Account Funding

panels.description: Current SOL balance of each configured economics reserve wallet returned by the selected source. A missing account omits only that wallet; an existing empty wallet publishes zero. No data means no configured wallet exists on the source, the economics target is not selected, or no complete snapshot has supplied balances. Use watcher readiness and snapshot freshness to detect failed current polls.
panels.title: Reserve Balances

panels.description: Completed percentage of the current epoch for the selected network.
panels.title: Epoch Progress

panels.description: Average slot duration from the latest Solana performance samples. The sparkline shows how recent slot timing has changed across the selected range.
panels.title: Average Slot Time

panels.description: Estimated time remaining in the current epoch. The sparkline shows the countdown adjusted by changes in recent slot duration.
panels.title: Time to Epoch End

panels.description: Estimated time until the next scheduled leader slot for each selected watched validator. Missing validators have no available current- or next-epoch assignment.
panels.title: Next Leader ETA
